_contract: What Phase-C2 Search-1 requires the pod's frozen assets to BE, checked by scripts/autoinit/verify_frozen_assets.py --expect before any scientific measurement. AUTHORIZES NOTHING.
_why_this_exists: C2 declared no expectation, so the verifier asked its HISTORICAL question against compiled-in Phase-A/C1 constants: it demanded artifacts/stage3/recovery_search_v2, which C2 neither stages nor needs, and recovery_search_scoring@v2 where the migrated tree legitimately reads @v3. SETUP_RC=91, no driver stage, nothing measured, $0.0552. Attempt 2's closeout has the full account.
_what_c2_consumes: exactly one frozen asset: state_eval_v1, the metric suite every searched candidate and the baseline B are ranked on. Without it there is no ranking. C2 trains nothing, scores no battery and consumes NO recovery scoring contract, so `scoring_contract` is deliberately ABSENT below rather than set to some value -- the verifier checks a contract only when an expectation asks for one.
_identities_are_derived_not_transcribed: the three values below are the canonical FROZEN['state_eval_v1'] entry in scripts/autoinit/verify_frozen_assets.py, which is where this project's state_eval identities are pinned. They are copied here because an expectation document is data the pod reads, and tests/pod/test_phase_c2_setup_contract.py re-derives them from that canonical source and refuses any drift -- so there is one source of truth and a guard, not two hand-maintained copies.
